text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Yikes, I think I goofed! Did I double
book
myself?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So the party at the shopping district,
right?
There's Hardcore Tag, and I'm
also supposed to
be at Granny Runway...
then there's Disco vs.
Club too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, we could just group them all into
one big
festival! That sounds hype! All
right!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Think Palmster'll come too? And then
there's
swing guy and his doggo... I
should invite the
alien who landed on
the beach too!
